title: Pin photodiode lit by a cw FDTD wave: window-averaged generation and responsivity (analytic)
description:
The time-domain twin of semiconductor/pin_photodiode_fdfd: the same lateral p+ / i / n+ silicon diode (4 x 0.2 um, 10 nm cells, contacts on the outer 0.1 um, V_reverse = 3 V fully depleting the 2 um absorber with its artificial band-to-band loss sigma_e = c eps0 n alpha_nom), lit by a cw 1.55 um plane-wave mode (em_fdtd_ez mode_source, P_in after the ramp 1 - exp(-t / (3 T)), y periodic, CPML along x) in a time_dependent study. em_semiconductor_generation (photon_wavelength = lambda0, required for a time-stepped source) hands the absorbed power averaged over a window to drift_diffusion, which re-solves (quasi-static) every 6720 EM steps; the EM time step is set (courant_factor) to exactly T / 224, so a window is exactly 30 optical periods and its mean of sigma E^2 has no cw ripple. Three windows (90 periods, 0.47 ps): the first is the turn-on, the solve at the end uses the steady later window(s) (ramp and transit residue < 1e-4).
Analytic (as the FDFD model, with the attenuation a of the discrete FDTD wave: Yee dispersion in space and time and the time-averaged conductivity term sigma cos(omega dt / 2) / Omega): A = (1 - R) (1 - exp(-a d)); every pair is collected, so I_photo = q lambda / (h c) A P_in and the responsivity is 1.25 A/W times A. The cw flux spectra (power_per_cw over the whole run) carry the ramp and arrival delay: x ((t_end - tau - t_d) / (t_end - tau))^2.
Derived values tab: P_front / P_trans (flux monitors, ~2e-3), G_total (integral of the coupled generation slot = photons per J times the window-mean absorbed power, ~2e-3), I_photo and responsivity from the cathode table, I_anode = -I_photo (~2e-3); tolerances 3e-3, to be confirmed by the first run.
Sweep tab: responsivity versus alpha_nom (0.5..2 per um) with its dashed curve.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 1 per um): G_profile (semiconductor.generation) along the diode, the Beer-Lambert decay over the absorber (tolerance 1e-2: the standing-wave ripple of the back-face reflection). Field tab: em.ez, semiconductor.generation, V, N, P.

parameters.name: V_reverse
parameters.description: reverse bias of the cathode in V (anode at 0 V)

parameters.name: alpha_nom
parameters.description: nominal power absorption coefficient of the absorber in 1/m (the sweep runs 0.5..2 per um)

parameters.name: P_in
parameters.description: cw mode source power in W per m of depth after the ramp (2D; low injection)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the cw source (also the photon wavelength)

parameters.name: omega0
parameters.description: angular frequency in rad/s

parameters.name: n_si
parameters.description: silicon index at 1.55 um (eps_r = n_si^2 = 12.08, the library value)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: h_planck
parameters.description: Planck constant in J s

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: diode length along x

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: period along y (periodic EM faces, insulating semiconductor faces)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: x_a0
parameters.description: absorber front face (a cell face)

parameters.name: x_a1
parameters.description: absorber back face

parameters.name: d_abs
parameters.description: absorber length in m

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre, p+ region), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_flux_up
parameters.description: flux monitor in front of the absorber (cell 80 centre)

parameters.name: x_flux_down
parameters.description: flux monitor behind the absorber (cell 350 centre)

parameters.name: steps_half_period
parameters.description: EM time steps per half optical period (sets the time step)

parameters.name: courant_em
parameters.description: courant_factor giving dt = T / 224 (0.979 of the 2D CFL limit)

parameters.name: dt_em
parameters.description: EM time step in s (23.1 as)

parameters.name: window_steps
parameters.description: EM steps per drift-diffusion solve = 60 half periods (the semiconductor every)

parameters.name: n_windows
parameters.description: drift-diffusion windows in the run

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration in s (20160 EM steps, 0.47 ps)

parameters.name: sigma_abs
parameters.description: optical conductivity sigma_e of the absorber in S/m (9.2e3 at 1 per um)

parameters.name: Omega_d
parameters.description: discrete-time frequency (2 / dt) sin(omega dt / 2) of the Yee update in rad/s

parameters.name: k_time
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber seen by the time-discrete update in 1/m

parameters.name: eps_imag
parameters.description: Im eps of the absorber in the semi-implicit conductivity update

parameters.name: eps_abs
parameters.description: |eps| of the absorber

parameters.name: kappa
parameters.description: extinction coefficient Im sqrt(eps) of the absorber

parameters.name: n_re
parameters.description: Re sqrt(eps) of the absorber

parameters.name: ksi0
parameters.description: half-cell phase n k dx / 2 (spatial grid-dispersion factor)

parameters.name: a_att
parameters.description: power attenuation coefficient of the discrete wave in 1/m

parameters.name: R_front
parameters.description: power reflection of the absorber front face

parameters.name: exit_factor
parameters.description: back-face power transmission over (1 - R) for a wave leaving an absorbing medium

parameters.name: A_ref
parameters.description: absorbed fraction (back-face reflection neglected)

parameters.name: P_abs_ref
parameters.description: analytic cw absorbed power in W/m

parameters.name: photons_per_J
parameters.description: photons per joule at lambda0 (7.80e18)

parameters.name: G_front
parameters.description: generation rate at the absorber front in 1/(m^3 s)

parameters.name: I_ref
parameters.description: analytic photocurrent in A/m (full collection)

parameters.name: resp_ref
parameters.description: analytic responsivity in A/W

parameters.name: tau_ramp
parameters.description: cw ramp time constant 3 T in s

parameters.name: dft_up
parameters.description: whole-run DFT factor of the delayed wave at the up monitor

parameters.name: dft_down
parameters.description: whole-run DFT factor of the delayed wave at the down monitor
